# authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rules (Data Source)

A rule of a Guard cluster trust: pods of one namespace running as one service account (or `*`, any of the namespace's) may join the network with their projected service account token. The node is named `<node_name_prefix>-<pod name>`, runs on platform `KUBERNETES`, is added to `node_group`, and counts against `max_nodes` (1 to 1000; unset is 100). `ephemeral` removes a node once it has been offline an hour, or as soon as its pod leaves: for Deployment and Job pods, not StatefulSet pods, which keep their node across restarts. Changes apply to joins from now on; joined nodes keep what they joined with. Deleting a rule stops further joins; joined nodes stay. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The kit tenant's id (`t-…`) the Guard row belongs to. Guard has no tenant of its own since the tenant collapse (tf#65). The provider's `tenant_id` is not used.

### Optional

- `cluster_trust_id` (String) Parent identifier `cluster_trust_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `network_id` (String) Parent identifier `network_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `guard_cluster_trust_rules` (Attributes List) Every cluster_trust_rule under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_cluster_trust_rules))
